direct_claims: This chart tracks the number of states involved in state-based conflicts over time, from 1946 to 2024.
It counts states that were primary participants in at least one interstate, intrastate, or extrasystemic conflict in each year.
The chart is presented by Our World in Data and cites the Uppsala Conflict Data Program and Peace Research Institute Oslo (2025) as the data source.
The data is organized by region: Asia and Oceania, Middle East, Europe, Americas, and Africa.
Because the values are stacked by region, the chart supports comparison of both the global total and the regional composition of that total in each year.
Exact year-by-year values for each region cannot be read confidently from the image alone without the withheld metadata.
